name: Rent and Utility Help (Community Resources & Advocacy)
description: CAPV's Community Resources & Advocacy program may be able to help with rent and utility bills, including a metered utility in danger of being shut off because of late payment. Complete an application to find out if you are eligible.
contact: 413-475-1570 (Info & Referral; leave name, phone, town, help needed; calls returned Mon-Fri)
documents_needed: Proof of identity for head of household
Proof of working income from within the last 90 days that covers 4 weeks in a row
Proof of non-working income (e.g. Social Security, unemployment, child support, disability)
Utility shut-off notice in an adult household member's name
Notices from landlord or court (for rent help)

requirements.text: Serves Hampshire and Franklin Counties and the North Quabbin Region of Massachusetts.
Utility help applies when a metered utility is in danger of being shut off because you are late paying; in Hampshire County, less than 4 weeks before shutoff.
For fuel delivery during the Fuel Assistance season, you must apply to that program first.
May be able to help with rent and utility bills. Complete an application to find out if you are eligible.

unknowns: Income limits (an eligibility chart is referenced on another page, not fetched)

first_step.title: Call CAPV's Info & Referral line
first_step.detail: Call 413-475-1570 and leave your name, phone, town and the help you need. Calls are returned Monday to Friday.
